subject: Phase 3 (FINAL) of the SwiftUI rebuild on mac/ios-shell-swiftui-phase3 (4765c24d) - review+land
body: ActiveSessionView ports the 1094-line ActiveSessionViewController and COMPLETES the view-layer rebuild: the lock screen + all six session screens are now SwiftUI; HostApp + ManagedApp stay UIKit (golden rule 3 + security surfaces). Ported by an agent, adversarially verified, findings folded: (1) UIColor(hex:) was defined ONLY in the retired VC and used by DesignSystem.swift for EVERY SG token - relocated to Utilities/UIColor+Hex.swift so retiring the VC does not break every colour. (2) restriction-row id was UUID() (fresh per access) so the 1s timer republish rebuilt all rows every second - now the unique title. (3) toast overlay was a sibling ABOVE the type cap (unbounded scale at AX4/AX5) - cap now outermost. (4) tenant-header text pinned white (fails WCAG on a light tenant primaryColor) - now white vs fixed charcoal by the fill's luminance. Colour doctrine verified correct + kept: session timer / refresh toast / app-tile link-dot use CHROME tokens not the decision palette the source misused; End Session keeps sgDeny as a destructive-confirm. Behaviour verbatim: app_launched audit row, managed-webview containment vs AppLauncher deeplink, endSession/refreshActiveSession/userDidInteract, every alert, the 1s countdown (thresholds unchanged), the sim demo auto-opens, kioskReleaseFailed recovery. NEW SHARED-LEDGER TOUCH: retiring the VC dropped mobile-native-engineer file coverage 19->18, which your role-coverage ratchet correctly refused - retired the claim (retiredOn/retiredWhy), logged ActiveSessionView (audited) + UIColor+Hex (read), re-blessed with --write, and regenerated the stale SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md. Verified: BUILD SUCCEEDED, ios-shell-repair 8/8, check-ios-dynamic-type + dead-stored-properties OK, preflight PASSED, breadth 56/0. Owed for a future visual pass (both need a build I have but did not screenshot this round): Enrolling retry-button contrast and the ActiveSession header at a11y-XL on a LIGHT-tenant config.
